subject: Marketplace security evidence intake — scope clarification and delivery plan
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudpartner.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace security evidence: SOC2 / pen test / DPA — listing intake

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the intro. We're starting the intake for NimbusTech's AWS & GCP marketplace listing and co-sell enablement. The marketplace security team on our side has a short packet they need to review before we can approve the co-sell asset — they asked specifically for: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (or an executive summary + date range)
- Pen test attestation/letter (signed by pen test vendor)
- Signed DPA / any redlines you already accept for marketplace transactions
- Short note on data residency/egress and whether KMS / customer-managed keys are supported

I've attached our intake spreadsheet (CP-marketplace-intake-2027.xlsx) with checkboxes and a desired timeline (we're targeting listing approval within 3 weeks). Can you confirm what you can provide and an estimated delivery date? Also flag any items that require legal/security review on our side (e.g., unusual DPA terms).

Small ask: if you can include a single-page SOC2 summary that explicitly lists in-scope services (serving runtime, control plane, auth) that will speed approval.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Cloud Partner Ops
CloudPartner Inc.
alicia@cloudpartner.com

Attachment: CP-marketplace-intake-2027.xlsx
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudpartner.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Marketplace security evidence: SOC2 / pen test / DPA — listing intake

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list and the intake file. Looping in Naomi (partner ops) and Kimberly (compliance) to handle the evidence handback.

High level: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II executive summary and the pen test attestation letter. We have a standard DPA we normally use for marketplace listings — I attached a redline-ready DOCX (redwood_dpa_redline_v1.docx) and can accept a short set of marketplace-specific clauses; if ACME's procurement needs custom language we'll route to legal.

Clarifying Qs so we can prioritize:
- Do you need the full SOC 2 report, or will an executive summary + auditor letter suffice for initial acceptance?
- Is the pen test attestation required to include remediation details, or just a dated letter from the vendor certifying no critical open findings?
- Any specific residency region for NimbusTech that we should call out (US-only, EU-only, or multi-region)?

Deliverables and ETA (tentative):
- SOC2 executive summary + auditor letter — by Thu 2027-06-17 EOD PT
- Pen test attestation (vendor letter) — by Fri 2027-06-18 EOD PT
- DPA redline copy — same day, Fri 2027-06-18

I'll upload the artifacts to a shared folder and send the link when everything is ready. If we need legal sign-off on any DPA redlines, Naomi will coordinate escalation.

If any of the timelines above are too aggressive for your program, say so and we'll adapt. Happy to do a 20-min sync tomorrow.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary_2027.pdf (attached), pen-test-attestation-2026.pdf (attached), redwood_dpa_redline_v1.docx (attached)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Marketplace security evidence: SOC2 / pen test / DPA — listing intake

Jordan / Naomi / Karthik — quick internal notes to make sure handback is consistent with our marketplace playbook: 

- SOC 2: the summary covers period 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31, Type II, in-scope: serving runtime, orchestration control plane, identity & access management, and SRE change controls. I'll include a one-line scope statement for the shared summary to match the intake ask.
- Pen test: vendor (RedProbe Security) provided an attestation dated 2026-11-30. No critical/urgent findings; there were two medium findings that were mitigated and re-tested. The attestation letter we send should reference remediation verification.
- DPA: we use the standard Redwood DPA for marketplace; there are two marketplace-specific clauses procurement sometimes requests (liability cap carve-out for co-sell transactions and basic egress logging terms). Naomi — can you confirm if NimbusTech asked for EU-only residency? If yes we need to include GCP region policy and a brief note on egress controls.

I'll draft a one-page summary for SOC2 and a 1-paragraph pen test summary to attach. Karthik — can you confirm the KMS/customer-managed-key support statement? We currently support CMKs on Dedicated and Private, and use server-side encryption with provider-managed keys for Hosted.

-K

Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudpartner.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Marketplace security evidence: SOC2 / pen test / DPA — listing intake

Hi Alicia — following up with the artifacts and a short handback plan. We've consolidated the files into a shared folder for NimbusTech's listing intake: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqZ9-Redwood-Marketplace-Evidence-2027

Files included in the folder:
- redwood_soc2_summary_2027.pdf — SOC 2 Type II exec summary (period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31). Scope: serving runtime, control plane, IAM, SRE change controls.
- pen-test-attestation-2026.pdf — RedProbe Security attestation (2026-11-30). Confirms remediation verification for two medium findings; no critical findings outstanding.
- redwood_dpa_redline_v1.docx — our standard DPA with commentary on the two marketplace clauses (liability carve-out + egress logging).

Quick notes on residency / keys:
- Hosted API: provider-managed keys, multi-region (US/EU) depending on customer selection; we can provide region-specific assurances in the listing text.
- Dedicated / Private: support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and can lock data to a region at deploy time.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm if the SOC2 exec summary + attestation satisfy your security intake (please reply to this thread).
2) If procurement needs DPA redlines accepted, let Naomi know and she'll route to legal for signature.
3) If you want remediation detail from the pen test report, Kimberly can provide a redacted remediation summary (sensitive details removed) — let us know.

We're aiming to have any requested DPA sign-off and final evidence acceptance by Wed 2027-06-23 to keep to your three-week timeline. If you'd like a 30-minute call to walk through the folder and the redlines, I'm available Mon/Tue morning PT.

Thanks,
Jordan
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachment references: redwood_soc2_summary_2027.pdf, pen-test-attestation-2026.pdf, redwood_dpa_redline_v1.docx
